verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents role-based authorization plus fine-grained Authorization Services, including role-based policies, resources, the Protection API, and UMA-based policy evaluation. Roles and permissions can be managed centrally via the admin console, the Admin CLI, or the REST API, and token introspection lets services validate access tokens. missing for 10: explicit documentation that role/permission claims are embedded in access/ID tokens (only implied by OIDC support), concrete enforcement examples in client apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of RBAC token claims.
